status: prepared, not launched; parent approval of scoped baseline reuse required
registered_treatment_change: Candidate-only reporting source, distinct from held combined candidate. Existing failed ledger baseline and combined registration remain unchanged; no claim that their gate passed. Reporting baseline is reused explicitly, not freshly replicated.
requested_effort: medium, not independent proof of actual effort
gates: Read every actual execution trace, arguments, stdin, tool results, persisted artifacts and case completion against supplied facts and authority. Bind every capture/report/manifest/artifact/native and separate assessment/replay record hash.
Check real command invocation and authoritative facts, exact canonical summary file, budget/continuation/fault handling, bucket precedence, health, economics and distinct prep outage.

Read both tracker and conversation actual publications and every discarded draft. Only unused drafts before publication may be projected by the existing assessor; wrong final publication, authority, extra summary call, cross-case/channel result, after-publication draft or missing case must fail.

Controlled identity rendering/publication and actual pinned cmdRunSummary handler with isolated dependency injection are the bounded boundary; no external acquisition, rendering quality, hosted publication or full unattended loop claim.
Exactly one matching actual native session per named sample, passing tool restriction/full-policy delivery audit.
Inspect expected actual model and native version against worker transcript, and worker guidance hashes against verified preflight.
Preserve complete native audit bytes/hash and source evidence; requested model/effort in runner manifest alone cannot prove actual execution.
Unchanged symmetric pre-publication-draft assessment only; preserve raw failures and all discarded drafts. No new normalisation.
Full worker guidance must match original worker-visible registered hashes, not host substitutes.
Six complete actual cases, canonical summaries, commands and both publications independently reviewed. Strict hold on any unpermitted raw, assessed, native or manual failure.

assessment.scope: Only existing unused pre-publication rendering drafts are projected; all final authority/facts/publications and all other operations stay strict. No new normalization.
required_order: Run native-tool-audit for exact arm plan, independently check actual model/version/guidance and full policy.
Copy the complete matching passing native audit bytes to RUN_DIRECTORY/native-audit.json and verify copy SHA256 equals original. Keep original audit and binding.
Run unchanged assessor; retain report.json, capture.json, all drafts, native evidence and literal runner exit/code1. Never overwrite raw report.
assessment.raw_failure: Retain raw/code1 even where the preregistered existing assessment passes; no blanket raw waiver.

prelaunch_requirements: Verify worker model/CLI and exact original worker guidance; do not assume host guidance equals worker bytes.
The host runner can read absolute /var/tmp policy path: pathlib evidence / absolute path resolves to the absolute path. Model receives policy via existing read_policy port.
For native audit inside worker, make the exact plan bytes readable there or stage an identical copy at a shared path; /var/tmp visibility is not assumed. No runner edits required.
Keep original baseline, plans, combined candidate registration and failed ledger evidence immutable.

cost_and_coverage.billing: Existing runner records provider_usage unmetered. Exact monetary cost unavailable; this consumes one actual Opus sample and full policy plus task/tool turns.
cost_and_coverage.coverage: Bounded reporting producer/command consumer with controlled identity normalisation/publication. No live acquisition, hosted publication, ledger execution, full unattended loop or statistical reliability claim. No current-main changed-kernel claim.
